dependencies.notes: Toolchain entry. dependencies.json selects Fil-C 0.685 (source https://fil-c.org/). Installed per F00 at /home/msaraiva/.local/fil-c/0.685 from the pinned v0.685 release assets; both tarball sizes and sha256 values were verified against the GitHub release API digests and re-checked by F00-verify. Cell mapping for this entry: the clang cell records the pizfix distribution (driver invoked as build/bin/clang; filc.json hello_world) and the filc cell records the /opt/fil optfil distribution (/opt/fil/bin/filcc; filc.json hello_world_optfil); the pizfix build/bin/filcc wrapper used by the Fil-C dependency probes is a symlink to the same clang-20 binary as the clang cell. Version string: clang version 20.1.8 (Fil-C 0.685 git@github.com:pizlonator/llvm-project-deluge.git bb0d0a64eed297ab8e171002033208fb08ad9941). pizfix needs no environment variables (the driver locates its slice relative to the compiler binary). /opt/fil is a bind mount of the local optfil tree; the mount is runtime state that does not survive reboot and is re-created by vendor/scripts/filc.sh (documented deviation F00-filc.md section 4; the vendor-canonical alternative is sudo ./setup.sh -u). There is no executable literally named filc or optfil in either distribution. The shared application flag set also compiles and runs hello with both compilers (filc.json notes). source_identity is null by design: the toolchain is pinned by release-asset size+sha256, not by a git commit of the built tree. license_file lists the license files present in the install (names recorded in filc.json notes; paths verified on disk). Releases all Fil-C builds.
